title: Fuobe Soul ID · character and look training
description: Train a character from a folder of photos you supply (local/characters/<name>/, 20+ photos of one consenting person: no sunglasses, groups, filters or cropped faces, one full-body shot), then make N images of them on each family's model. Identity is measured against the same photos, and A/B'd against the same element used as reference photos on an edit model. Set "consent": true in your copy only when the person agreed. The look case trains a moodboard's style (local/styles/<name>/, 20+ images in one style) and measures style against those images. Demo runs don't train (they use reference images on drawn faces). Use Fuobe-owned or licensed photos only, never Higgsfield outputs.

trained.description: The trained LoRA, @mentioned in every prompt, at full character strength

half-strength.description: The same LoRA at half character strength (scale 0.8): does the likeness hold while the scene follows the prompt better?

references.description: No training: the same element's photos as references on an edit model (open) or a partner model (cloud), the bar Soul ID has to clear
